hash_format: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON sorted keys, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false, compact separators; no newline

pricing.reservation_accounting: All input conservatively charged at 0.125/MTok, output including reasoning at 0.50/MTok; no cache discount or double counting reasoning. Explicit 30m TTL. 12h writes/other tiers/regional endpoints prohibited; unexpected usage stops.

accounting.mechanism: Existing shared_allowance Authority + amend_shared_allowance.py, new fixed portuguese_acceptance phase; no second ledger
accounting.authorization: Existing earlier paid scopes are exhausted and do not authorize this new Portuguese session. New owner approval must explicitly cover 25->28 and this frozen proposal; no activation in preparation.
accounting.reservation: Status -> fresh UUID reserve -> exactly one dispatch -> settle real numeric usage before parse -> verify durable receipt -> acknowledge. No refunds of permits/lifetime reservations.
accounting.interruption: Stop all remaining cases. Use same-permit lookup/settlement/acknowledgement from genuine recorded usage only. Uncertain usage retains full hold and globally blocks; never manufacture zero or retry model.
accounting.closure: Disconnect key first, inspect/settle existing permits, use supported attributable stop on new scope (unused permits stay closed), remove proposed API egress and CA/session configuration, stop native authority. Earlier policy scopes/history remain retained and inactive.

preflight_order: Verify exact sources, serving images, current internal-network config, registration, contracts, dataset/reviewer and preserved designs; stop on drift
Only under separate approval apply proposed API-only egress/CA configuration with provider key empty; preserve private internal network and all other components
Verify fresh certificate, hostname and loopback reachability using non-accounting nonce probe; never widen listener, bypass TLS or silently change routing
Read-only exact-file authority dry-run, history/audit verification, 25 settled records, zero unresolved, original money sufficient; then supported apply only with attributable owner approval

Start existing native authority on 127.0.0.1:29489 with the new reviewed host operator source; real provider key remains disconnected until verified authenticated status reports 25/28 and new scope 0/3 with zero outstanding

Revalidate declared context and ensure framed input including actual carried history <=32000 before each fresh reserve. Connect only retained private key to exact restricted reviewer; no metered connectivity/model-list probe
Run A then B then C only through visible Design with AI controls; all later cases conditional on preceding pass; no arbitrary followup
No runtime readiness probe, workflow submission, execution grant, worker start or algorithm. All execution restrictions stay enforced
On response failure, drift, uncertain accounting, deadline or cap stop and close; never reword/retry/repair responses
Record actual raw sanitized response, structured result, context/revisions, control outcomes, response/model ID, usage/costs/outstanding and immutable preservation checks before closure

preflight_transport.blocker: Retained API has only ai-effect-pt-parameters_private, internal=true; host.docker.internal lookup fails with socket.gaierror [Errno -3] Temporary failure in name resolution. No accounting request reached Windows.

time_limit: One supervised session <=30 minutes from activation. Recheck official pricing and unexpired TLS before activation; any changed frozen configuration requires a revised review/approval.
